auth_description: SpotHero consumer endpoints at spothero.com/api/v1 use browser session cookies. Sign in at spothero.com, then auth login --chrome or --cookies-file. Not the partner X-API-Key API.
description: Agent-native CLI for SpotHero consumer accounts: search parking, list reservations, and hard-gated book/cancel.

novel_features.name: Hard-gated live booking
novel_features.description: Charges only with --enable-live-booking --owner-approved --confirm "PLACE SPOTHERO BOOKING"; book preview never posts checkout.

novel_features.name: Token-gated cancellation
novel_features.description: cancel preview issues a short-lived confirm token; cancel requires --yes --confirm <token>.

novel_features.name: Consumer session auth
novel_features.description: Chrome or Playwright storage-state cookie import; secrets stored mode 0600, never printed.
